# Version 4.148.1 (Unreleased)
> **Typeface race fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.1 fixes a macOS typeface data race in the bundled Skia engine.

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **macOS typeface access is thread-safe** — The bundled Skia engine eliminates a race involving the cached font stream in SkTypeface_Mac. ([#4262](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4262))
